scripts.text:
[Esseray]
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
初心者世界的一位傳奇人物去了克魔島辦事，之後就失蹤了。
你去找找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能為你指引正確的道路...

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
You're looking good.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哦？你是初心者協會的成員嗎？
看起來精神不錯嘛。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You look full of energy...
You seem strong enough to endure the test.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你看起來精力充沛...
應該有實力通過考驗。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
我知道一種變強的方法。你願意試試嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm okay now.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我現在這樣就好

scripts.text: I want to be stronger!
scripts.translation: 我想變得更強！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
Live a normal life then.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
如果你甘於平庸，我也幫不了你。
那就過普通人的生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Good!
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
很好！
初心者世界的一位傳奇人物去了克魔島辦事，之後就失蹤了。
你去找找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能為你指引正確的道路...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Sh --------- !!
Be quiet please.
You'll scare the fish.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
噓——！！
請安靜點。
會把魚嚇跑的。

scripts.text: Hmm... 'scuse me...
scripts.translation: 嗯...抱歉，打擾了...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Aaaaaaak!!
What are you doing?
I told you be quiet!
They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
啊啊啊！！
你在幹什麼？
我不是叫你安靜點嗎！
吵死了，魚都遊走了~

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
(-- sh--aking --)
Who... are you?
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
（渾身發抖）
你...是誰？
為什麼要打擾我釣魚？

scripts.text: I have a delivery from Esseray...
scripts.translation: 我替艾瑟雷送東西來...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What? Esseray? Esseray?
Hmm! I know him...
Esseray... Esseray... hmm.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什麼？艾瑟雷？艾瑟雷？
嗯！我認識他...
艾瑟雷...艾瑟雷...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Ahhhh --- !! ----- Ahhhh ---!!
Got it! --- Got it!
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
Esseray, right? Wrong?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
啊——！！——啊——！！
想起來了！想起來了！
^0000FF是艾爾帕蘭初心者協會的成員。^000000
艾瑟雷，對吧？沒錯吧？

scripts.text: No he isn't
scripts.translation: 不是他

scripts.text: Yes, right
scripts.translation: 沒錯

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
呼呼~我的直覺還挺靈的...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
So what do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
那麼，你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What?! He isn't?
Then where is Esseray from?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什麼？！不是他？
那艾瑟雷是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What -------- !!
That isn't important, right?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什——麼！！
這不重要，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Then -------- !!
Why did you come here?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
那——麼！！
你為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text: - You explain why you're here. -
scripts.translation: - 你解釋了自己來這裡的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
嗯...這問題說簡單也簡單，說難也難。

scripts.text: - You hear a voice complaining about something. -
scripts.translation: - 你聽見有人在抱怨。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
艾瑟雷！那個該死的混蛋，竟然毀了我的假期...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Haaaaa~
My poor life~
Ahhh~ so many problems.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
唉~我這苦命的人生~
啊~煩心事真多。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Too ~ hard. Hey, little kid!
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
太~難受了。喂，小鬼！
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: {0}, how about you?

[Nodor]
My name is Nodor! Nodor.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我叫諾多爾！諾多爾。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿！你心裡想什麼，全寫在臉上了~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
Condor and Odor...
Don't try to fool me.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
就因為我叫諾多爾，從小到大大家都拿我開玩笑。
什麼“禿鷹”和“臭味”...
別想騙我。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Whatever the reason is... you are here!
Let's get together to go further.
Come again after a while~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
不管你為什麼來...反正你已經來了！
我們一起繼續前進吧。
過一會兒再來找我~

scripts.text: - Talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 再和他聊聊。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm ----- !!
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -
scripts.translation: - 諾多爾狐疑地看著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你不知道^0000FF超級初心者^000000有多厲害嗎？

scripts.text: - Nodor asks with confidence. -
scripts.translation: - 諾多爾自信地問道。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice~
Do you know who I am?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
喂，超級初心者~
你知道我是誰嗎？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?!
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heh...
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呵呵...
膽子不小嘛？

scripts.text: - This guy is a weirdo. -
scripts.translation: - 這傢伙真古怪。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice ~
I will make you stronger!
So will you believe what I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
喂，超級初心者~
我能讓你變強！
你願意相信我說的話嗎？

scripts.text: I won't follow you.
scripts.translation: 我才不聽你的。

scripts.text: Why not? kehehe~
scripts.translation: 為什麼不聽？嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
I'd love to do nothing too.
Just let me fish if you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
要拒絕我？你不想變強嗎？
其實我也樂得什麼都不做。
你想走的話，就讓我繼續釣魚吧。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm~ Do I sound harsh?
Hmm, I can't help using such words.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯哼~我說話很兇嗎？
沒辦法，我就是這副口氣。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't sweat it.
It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別擔心，教你變強對我來說小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Great~!
What is your issue?
You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
太好了~！
你遇到什麼難題了？
是不知道怎麼變強，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I can't get stronger.
scripts.translation: 是的，我沒法變強。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhmmm ~!
There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
tell you how.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯~！
確實有辦法...
雖然有危險，但我可以告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
How about it?
Are you willing to do this?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我只有一個條件：別問問題，我說什麼你就做什麼！
怎麼樣？
你願意嗎？

scripts.text: No, I will not!
scripts.translation: 不，我才不幹！

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 好，就這麼辦！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
只有變強才能活下去！
你想一輩子當弱者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I will give you a tip.
You can't always be right.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
給你個建議：
你不可能永遠正確。
有時得放下自尊，聽聽別人的意見。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
All right --------- !!
Your passion will make you stronger.
You calm?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
很好——！！
你的熱情會讓你變得更強。
冷靜下來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What I want you to do is...
Hunt 1,000 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我要你做的事就是...
獵殺1,000只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Do you know what this is for?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
知道我為什麼要你這麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你知道什麼是^FF0000{0}^000000魔物吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hunt 1,000!
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
獵殺 1,000 只！
別說你做不到！
我知道數量不少，不過它們弱得很！

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Huh huh~!
Rembember, no questions!
Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呵呵~記住，不許問問題！
獵殺完1,000只再回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Nodor!

[Nodor]
Oh my god!
So frightened... let me see?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
天哪！
嚇死我了...讓我看看？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice!
Didn't I say to hunt 1,000?
Don't come back until you have.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
喂，超級初心者！
我不是叫你去獵殺1,000只嗎？
沒完成就別回來。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you hunted all 1,000 already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你已經獵殺完1,000只了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你比我想像的能幹嘛。
對了，我叫你獵殺什麼魔物來著？

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Lunatic
scripts.translation: 瘋兔

scripts.text: Fabre
scripts.translation: 綠棉蟲

scripts.text: Picky
scripts.translation: 小雞

scripts.text: Baphomet
scripts.translation: 巴風特

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿嘿？你真能獨自獵殺巴風特？
少騙人了！！小心我揍你！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't tell a lie!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別撒謊！
我叫你獵殺的不是這個！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
keheheheheheh~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You annoyed me so I made you do this task...
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你惹惱我了，所以我才故意給你這項任務...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Wow! You actually hunted all 1,000?
I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哇！你居然真的獵殺完1,000只了？
看來你想變強的決心確實不容小覷。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Okay! So far so good.
I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
好！到目前為止都不錯。
我來告訴你怎麼彌補實力上的不足。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh! You already came here?
Didn't you say you have something to handle?
You have enough passion but...
you need to learn patience.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哦！你這麼快就回來了？
你不是說還有事情要處理嗎？
熱情是夠了...
不過還得學會耐心。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhhhhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呼~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh sorry! Sorry!
I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
啊，抱歉！抱歉！
我很久以前收到哥哥的一封信，你要不要讀讀看，瞭解一下情況？

scripts.text: Yes, I will
scripts.translation: 好，我讀

scripts.text: No, I won't
scripts.translation: 不，我不讀

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You should read more!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你該多讀點書！

scripts.text: - He throws a bundled letter at you. -
scripts.translation: - 他把一封捲起來的信扔給你。 -

scripts.text:
Dear Bro. Nodor,
 
Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.
scripts.translation:
親愛的諾多爾哥哥：
 
哥哥你好，我是你弟弟努多爾。最近怎麼樣？我寫信是想說...
我需要錢買吃的。你那麼有錢，幫幫我吧。

scripts.text:
If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
- The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
要是不幫我...還記得上次你%$&*@*&%$...
- 信被揉皺了，後面的內容看不清。 -
我還在修瓦爾茨巴爾德共和國。
~ 努多爾

scripts.text: - You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -
scripts.translation: - 讀完這封信，你感到一陣不安。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hu~u~
Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
It's got to be my fame... T_T
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呼~
嗯，我就一個弟弟，他總是找我要錢。
一定是因為我太有名了... T_T

scripts.text: - Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -
scripts.translation: - 現在你真的感到不安了。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey- Super Novice {0}!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿，超級初心者{0}！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你可以給我哥哥一些錢。他在飛空艇上。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you visited already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你已經去看過他了嗎？

scripts.text: How much money should I give?
scripts.translation: 該給他多少錢？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
Give him a little, ya~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哦，你還沒去啊？
給他一點錢嘛~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
100,000 zeny is okay~
1,000,000 zeny is okay~
10,000,000 zeny is okay~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
100,000 Zeny 就好~
1,000,000 Zeny 也好~
10,000,000 Zeny 也可以~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey, have you gone there?
I got another message from my bro.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿，你去過了嗎？
我又收到弟弟的訊息了。

scripts.text:
Bro, someone gave me...
{0} Zeny.
You do care about me...
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
哥哥，有人給了我...
{0} Zeny。
你果然還是關心我的...
~ 努多爾

scripts.text: He seemed so hungry...
scripts.translation: 他看起來好餓...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
By the way...
{0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
對了...
考慮到我的名氣，{0} Zeny也太少了吧？你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Anyway~
{0} Zeny...
Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
總之~
{0} Zeny...
你不覺得給得太少了嗎？我的名聲都要受影響了。

scripts.text: Hey...

[Nodor]
Wow, you've got my point already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哇，你已經明白我的意思了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I think you are right.
This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我覺得你說得對。
這項考驗考的是你能不能喚起別人的同情心。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我是說你的消費習慣和直覺...
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Hey, that's not my...
scripts.translation: 喂，我不是...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hmm? Ah...
I almost forgot to tell
you how to exceed your limit,
didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯？啊...
我差點忘了告訴你
怎麼突破極限，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
咳咳！我派你去可不是為了打發時間！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What the? --- ah? --- !!

[Nodor]
Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
We... have to run...!!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
小心！！一群巨石怪追過來了！
我們...得快跑...！！！

scripts.text: What?!
scripts.translation: 什麼？！

scripts.text: Um?
scripts.translation: 嗯？

scripts.text:
- You look around, and -
- there is nothing behind you. -
- When you are about to doubt... -
scripts.translation:
- 你環顧四周，-
- 身後卻空無一物。 -
- 正當你心生懷疑時... -

scripts.text:
- You ask Nodor once -
- again in your fright... -
scripts.translation:
- 你驚慌地-
- 又問了諾多爾一次... -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
I can't make you stronger until you use those points.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你還有沒用完的技能點。
用完這些點數之前，我沒法讓你變強。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Puhahahahahahahahahahah!!
Good! You scared yet?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
噗哈哈哈哈哈！！
很好！嚇到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Sorry for scaring you!
I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
抱歉嚇到你了！
我覺得，初心者的職責和使命就是讓每一天都充滿歡樂。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
Feel your body lighter than before...?
Or more powerful?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
那麼，你有沒有感覺到變化？
身體是不是比以前輕盈了...？
或者更有力了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh--- My--- (tut,tut,tut)!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哦——天——（嘖嘖嘖）！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Mr. Sieu Ngu --
Not to be mean, but
you are a little dull...
Don't you feel different now?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
西烏·恩古先生——
我不是故意說你，不過你反應有點遲鈍...
現在還沒感覺到變化嗎？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text: I got it!
scripts.translation: 我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You already exceeded your limit.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
啊——對，你確實有點遲鈍。
你已經突破極限了。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can be stronger than before.
Wasn't it your dream?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你現在比以前更強了。
這不就是你的夢想嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Ok~!
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
That's it!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
好~！
去世界各地闖蕩吧，繼續做個初心者，享受自由快樂的生活！
就這樣！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
(Pouting) ------------- !!
So you're finally back.

[Nodor]
To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
為了慶祝又有一位初心者夥伴加入，我準備了一些裝備送給你——

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
And don't say I didn't warn you either.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
記得確認^FF0000背包^000000裡有足夠空間，才能收下這些物品。
我可提醒過你了。

scripts.text: Yes, let me check my inventory.
scripts.translation: 好，我先檢查一下背包。

scripts.text: I'm good, show me.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了，給我看看。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well, well!
You know! Have no regrets.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哎呀！
你看，拿了可別後悔哦。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
but they are still good.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
這些是我年輕時穿戴過的裝備，
不過現在依然很好用。

scripts.text: Second-hand stuff, huh?
scripts.translation: 二手貨啊？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Give them back to me.
How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
還給我！
我把自己的東西送給你，你怎麼能這樣反應？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I...
I can't take back what I already gave away.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我...
送出去的東西可不能收回來。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Now I am going to say greetings again.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
現在，我要重新向你致意。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
願超級初心者{0}獲得超級初心者守護者的祝福！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget that you are a Novice.
Be a Novice always!
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別忘了你是初心者。
永遠做個初心者吧！
人生的目標就是過得自在、平凡！

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hush!
Please be quiet because you'll
scare all the fish away.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
噓！
請安靜點，
會把魚都嚇跑的。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊~我沒錢買吃的。
我餓死了，可不知道哥哥什麼時候才回來...

scripts.text: Hey, are you... Mr. Nudor?
scripts.translation: 喂，你是...努多爾先生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eeeeeh?! Who wants to know?
Do I know you?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
咦？！你打聽這個幹嗎？
我認識你嗎？

scripts.text: - You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -
scripts.translation: - 你向努多爾說明了來找他的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊哈！你是替我哥哥來給我零花錢的吧~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哇哇哇~~他給了你多少？

scripts.text:
- Nudor stares with twinkling -
- eyes, holding out his hands. -
- How much do you want to give? -
scripts.translation:
- 努多爾眼睛閃閃發亮，-
- 伸出雙手等著。 -
- 你想給他多少？ -

scripts.text: I have no money
scripts.translation: 我沒錢

scripts.text: Give 100,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 給100,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 300,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 給300,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 1,000,000 Zeny
Give all the money you have
scripts.translation: 把身上的錢全給你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- crying -
I hate Nodor --- !
I hate you too --- !
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
- 哭著說 -
我討厭諾多爾——！
我也討厭你——！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
太棒了~~他給了你{0} Zeny？真大方！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哦...天哪，你真的要把身上所有的Zeny都給我？真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
What? But where is {0} Zeny?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
什麼？那{0} Zeny呢？

scripts.text: No, not really...
scripts.translation: 不，還是算了...

scripts.text: Give it all
scripts.translation: 全給你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Pshaw! How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
嘁！真讓人失望！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
咦？可你身上一分錢都沒有。你這麼窮啊？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
I can't believe it...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哇~！！{0} Zeny！這可幫大忙了~嘿嘿~
真不敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Did you know? You're really handsome~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
你知道嗎？你真的好帥~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
我得告訴你，你真的...真的~好漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- You feel like you're being -
- tricked, so go back to Nodor. -
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
- 你覺得自己好像被耍了，-
- 於是回去找諾多爾。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
真不敢相信哥哥真的給我寄錢了...我太喜歡了~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ooooops!
{0}, hush --- !!

[Nudor]
Don't tell Nodor about this~~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
別告訴諾多爾這件事哦~~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊~我沒錢買吃的。
我餓死了，可不知道哥哥什麼時候才回來...
